reviews.title: Must have when not crashing!
reviews.text:
This has been one of my staple apps I keep on my Home Screen for quick document/receipt scans that I can save to numerous locations on my phone and in the cloud. 

Unfortunately, this most recent version routinely crashes before the scanned document is processed. For whatever reason, as soon as you hit the process button for the most recent scanned document(s), the app crashes. Idk why it happens every time on the first attempt to process docs, but once you reopen the app and rescan the documents, the second attempt to process the most recent docs works. It’s kinda bizarre but that has been my experience the past dozen or so times I’ve used this app. 

Once they inevitably fix this issue that has been plaguing this app for the past several months, this is a 5 star app! Very user friendly as well!
